frame.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE exquisite square reusable fantasy-game weapon-item frame and empty backdrop for 512x512 pixel item icons, derived from the material craftsmanship and premium feel of the attached Eastern Arms Merchant item icon. Output square 1:1, preferably exactly 512x512, crisp readability at that small size.
THIS IMAGE CONTAINS ONLY THE EMPTY FRAME AND BACKDROP. NO GUN, no weapon, no text or nameplate.
Design an extremely refined narrow rectangular champagne-gold outer molding with platinum-silver inner bevel, small elegant gold/silver acanthus-and-cloud filigree at the four corners, tiny centered ornamental clasps at top and bottom. The straight frame strips occupy only about 2.5% of width; corner accents extend at most 9% inward. Keep the middle left/right portions thin so long guns can occupy 88% of the width without touching ornaments. Perfect straight square frame, balanced restrained high-end jewelry-level metal workmanship. No giant crown, no face, no dragons, no large central medallion, no empty name banner or rank badge.
Backdrop fills the square: near-black obsidian transitioning to very deep warm burgundy-black in the center, a subtle diffuse warm golden central illumination, sparse microscopic gilded dust close to corners, delicate radial glow with no busy pattern. It should feel luxurious and atmospheric while the weapon to be placed later remains the obvious focus. Match the attached item's semi-real hand-painted premium game equipment style and delicate gilded border, add visible silver-metal accents. No gray checkerboard, no letters, numbers, logos or watermark. Frame is fully contained in the square with outer corners uncut.

icons.prompt:
Use case: compositing. Create the FINAL square premium equipment item icon for user weapon 1, designed to look beautiful at exactly 512x512 pixels. ONE ICON ONLY, square 1:1 output, preferably 512x512. Image 1 is the finished weapon cutout and is the authoritative gun appearance; image 2 is the exact shared gold-and-silver square frame plus burgundy-black backdrop. Preserve the frame design and colors of image 2 closely and place the weapon from image 1 inside it. Do not redesign either.
MANDATORY DIRECTION: muzzle/barrel points to the LEFT; stock is to the RIGHT. The weapon already faces LEFT: preserve its orientation.
Center the complete weapon horizontally at the optical center of the square, nearly horizontal, with approximately 86–88% total canvas width and adequate margins at left muzzle/right stock. Preserve the original weapon proportions without stretching or shortening. Leave every part of the gun including charms, butterflies, pearls, all barrel tips and magazine fully visible and separated from the border. Add only a soft warm illumination behind the gun for separation and extremely subtle close edge highlights, no extra sculpture and no new attachments. Keep the backdrop very dark behind pale metal so the gold/silver detail reads cleanly at 512.
Keep the exact gold/silver P90-like bullpup, two flip-up sights, black barrel at LEFT, pearl star bow and warm golden bear chamber on RIGHT, with intricate engraved panels.



Quality: high-end crisp semi-real game icon. Gun receiver-to-barrel-to-muzzle axis perfectly straight, no bends at the connections; aligned upper rail, coherent perspective; no wavy barrel. The ONLY changes to weapon are whole-object mirroring when specified, uniform scale, positioning and light integration. Keep the same ornate thin gold outer frame, silver bevel, four corner scrolls and small top/bottom clasps as reference 2, fully visible. No text, letters, numbers, logos, ranks, nameplate or watermark. No additional weapon. Do not crop the frame or gun.
